text.zh-Hant: 床頭靠實牆。
text.zh-Hans: 床头靠实墙。
text.en: Put the head of the bed against a solid wall.

why.zh-Hant: 背後有牆，睡時較有安定感，也少受窗邊冷風與光線干擾；傳統上稱為「背後有靠」。
why.zh-Hans: 背后有墙，睡时较有安定感，也少受窗边冷风与光线干扰；传统上称为“背后有靠”。
why.en: A wall behind you feels settled and keeps window draughts and light off your head; tradition calls this having support behind you.

text.zh-Hant: 床不正對房門，躺下時能看見門口。
text.zh-Hans: 床不正对房门，躺下时能看见门口。
text.en: Keep the bed out of line with the door, but where you can see the door when lying down.

why.zh-Hant: 門口的光線、聲音與走動不直衝床上，睡得較安穩；看得見門口也讓人放心。
why.zh-Hans: 门口的光线、声音与走动不直冲床上，睡得较安稳；看得见门口也让人放心。
why.en: Light, noise and footsteps from the doorway don't run straight at the bed, and seeing the door puts the mind at rest.

text.zh-Hant: 鏡子不正對床。
text.zh-Hans: 镜子不正对床。
text.en: Don't let a mirror face the bed.

why.zh-Hant: 夜裡醒來時，鏡中的影像和反光容易讓人一驚，也可能影響入睡；可以移開，或睡前用布遮上。
why.zh-Hans: 夜里醒来时，镜中的影像和反光容易让人一惊，也可能影响入睡；可以移开，或睡前用布遮上。
why.en: A reflection or a glint at night can startle you awake or keep you from sleep; move the mirror, or cover it at bedtime.

text.zh-Hant: 床的上方不放沉重的櫃子或吊飾，也避開橫樑。
text.zh-Hans: 床的上方不放沉重的柜子或吊饰，也避开横梁。
text.en: Keep heavy shelves and hanging things off the wall above the bed, and don't sleep under a beam.

why.zh-Hant: 頭頂有重物或橫樑會帶來壓迫感，萬一掉落也危險。
why.zh-Hans: 头顶有重物或横梁会带来压迫感，万一掉落也危险。
why.en: Weight overhead feels oppressive, and anything that falls is a danger.

text.zh-Hant: 床底與床邊保持整潔通風。
text.zh-Hans: 床底与床边保持整洁通风。
text.en: Keep under and around the bed clear and airy.

why.zh-Hant: 少堆雜物，灰塵少、空氣流通，房間也顯得輕鬆。
why.zh-Hans: 少堆杂物，灰尘少、空气流通，房间也显得轻松。
why.en: Less clutter means less dust and better air, and the room feels lighter.

text.zh-Hant: 臥室用柔和、可調暗的燈光，色調安靜。
text.zh-Hans: 卧室用柔和、可调暗的灯光，色调安静。
text.en: Use soft, dimmable light and calm colours in the bedroom.

why.zh-Hant: 睡前把光線放柔，身體較容易進入休息狀態。
why.zh-Hans: 睡前把光线放柔，身体较容易进入休息状态。
why.en: Softer light before sleep helps the body wind down.

text.zh-Hant: 書桌宜背靠實牆，背後不要是走道或窗。
text.zh-Hans: 书桌宜背靠实墙，背后不要是走道或窗。
text.en: Sit with a solid wall behind your desk, not a walkway or a window.

why.zh-Hant: 背後有靠，專心時不會被身後的走動或光線打擾；傳統上稱為「背後有靠」。
why.zh-Hans: 背后有靠，专心时不会被身后的走动或光线打扰；传统上称为“背后有靠”。
why.en: With support behind you, footsteps and glare behind you don't break your focus; tradition calls this having support behind you.

text.zh-Hant: 坐著能看見門口，但不正對門。
text.zh-Hans: 坐着能看见门口，但不正对门。
text.en: Sit where you can see the door, but not directly facing it.

why.zh-Hant: 看得到誰進來，心裡較踏實；不正對門，就不會被進出的人直接打斷。
why.zh-Hans: 看得到谁进来，心里较踏实；不正对门，就不会被进出的人直接打断。
why.en: Seeing who comes in is reassuring; not facing the door straight on keeps comings and goings from interrupting you.

text.zh-Hant: 光線從側面來，避免窗戶在螢幕正後方或正前方。
text.zh-Hans: 光线从侧面来，避免窗户在屏幕正后方或正前方。
text.en: Let light come from the side; avoid a window right behind or right in front of the screen.

why.zh-Hant: 側光不刺眼，螢幕上也少反光，眼睛較不累。
why.zh-Hans: 侧光不刺眼，屏幕上也少反光，眼睛较不累。
why.en: Side light doesn't glare and puts fewer reflections on the screen, so the eyes tire less.

text.zh-Hant: 桌面只放正在用的東西，常用物品放在順手的位置。
text.zh-Hans: 桌面只放正在用的东西，常用物品放在顺手的位置。
text.en: Keep only what you're using on the desk, and everyday things within easy reach.

why.zh-Hant: 桌面清爽，開始做事時就少一道整理的阻力。
why.zh-Hans: 桌面清爽，开始做事时就少一道整理的阻力。
why.en: A clear desk removes one hurdle before you start.

text.zh-Hant: 座位避免被尖角或柱角正對。
text.zh-Hans: 座位避免被尖角或柱角正对。
text.en: Don't let a sharp corner or the edge of a pillar point at your seat.

why.zh-Hant: 尖角對著人會讓人下意識不自在，也容易碰撞；可以移動座位，或用植物、布簾柔化。
why.zh-Hans: 尖角对着人会让人下意识不自在，也容易碰撞；可以移动座位，或用植物、布帘柔化。
why.en: A corner aimed at you feels uneasy without your noticing, and it's easy to bump; move the seat, or soften the corner with a plant or a curtain.

text.zh-Hant: 沙發背後靠牆，坐著能看見入口。
text.zh-Hans: 沙发背后靠墙，坐着能看见入口。
text.en: Put the sofa's back to a wall, where you can see the way in.

why.zh-Hant: 背後有靠、看得見入口，坐著較放鬆。
why.zh-Hans: 背后有靠、看得见入口，坐着较放松。
why.en: Support behind and a view of the entrance make it easier to relax.

text.zh-Hant: 走道保持通暢，家具不擋住門和窗。
text.zh-Hans: 走道保持通畅，家具不挡住门和窗。
text.en: Keep walkways open, and don't block doors and windows with furniture.

why.zh-Hant: 走動順手，空氣與光線也能進來；傳統上把這叫做讓「氣」流通。
why.zh-Hans: 走动顺手，空气与光线也能进来；传统上把这叫做让“气”流通。
why.en: Moving around is easy, and light and air can come in; tradition calls this letting the qi flow.

text.zh-Hant: 白天多用自然光，晚上光線溫暖均勻，不留陰暗的角落。
text.zh-Hans: 白天多用自然光，晚上光线温暖均匀，不留阴暗的角落。
text.en: Use daylight in the day and warm, even light at night, with no dark corners.

why.zh-Hant: 明亮均勻的空間讓人精神好，也比較安全。
why.zh-Hans: 明亮均匀的空间让人精神好，也比较安全。
why.en: An evenly lit room keeps you alert, and it is safer.

text.zh-Hant: 放一兩盆容易照顧的植物。
text.zh-Hans: 放一两盆容易照顾的植物。
text.en: Keep one or two easy-care plants.

why.zh-Hant: 植物讓空間有生氣，照顧它們也是一種放鬆。
why.zh-Hans: 植物让空间有生气，照顾它们也是一种放松。
why.en: Plants bring the room to life, and tending them is a way to unwind.

text.zh-Hant: 大門若一眼直通窗戶或陽台，可以用屏風、櫃子或植物稍作遮擋。
text.zh-Hans: 大门若一眼直通窗户或阳台，可以用屏风、柜子或植物稍作遮挡。
text.en: If the front door looks straight through to a window or balcony, partly screen the line with a screen, a cabinet or plants.

why.zh-Hant: 進門時不會一眼看穿整個家，多一分隱私；傳統上認為這樣「氣」不會直進直出。
why.zh-Hans: 进门时不会一眼看穿整个家，多一分隐私；传统上认为这样“气”不会直进直出。
why.en: The home isn't seen through at a glance, which adds privacy; tradition holds that the qi then doesn't rush straight in and out.

text.zh-Hant: 爐灶與水槽不正對，也不緊貼。
text.zh-Hans: 炉灶与水槽不正对，也不紧贴。
text.en: Don't put the stove directly opposite the sink or right against it.

why.zh-Hant: 兩者之間留出工作檯，備料與烹調都順手，也較安全；傳統上講究把水與火分開。
why.zh-Hans: 两者之间留出工作台，备料与烹调都顺手，也较安全；传统上讲究把水与火分开。
why.en: A worktop between them makes prep and cooking easier and safer; tradition keeps water and fire apart.

text.zh-Hant: 爐灶背後是實牆，不在窗下。
text.zh-Hans: 炉灶背后是实墙，不在窗下。
text.en: Back the stove onto a solid wall, not under a window.

why.zh-Hant: 窗邊的風會吹動火焰，窗簾也可能靠近火源。
why.zh-Hans: 窗边的风会吹动火焰，窗帘也可能靠近火源。
why.en: A draught from the window moves the flame, and a curtain may come near it.

text.zh-Hant: 保持通風與整潔，刀具收好。
text.zh-Hans: 保持通风与整洁，刀具收好。
text.en: Keep the kitchen aired and tidy, and put knives away.

why.zh-Hant: 油煙散得快，空氣清新；刀具收好也更安全。
why.zh-Hans: 油烟散得快，空气清新；刀具收好也更安全。
why.en: Cooking fumes clear quickly, and stored knives are safer.

text.zh-Hant: 工作檯上方要有足夠的燈光。
text.zh-Hans: 工作台上方要有足够的灯光。
text.en: Light the worktop well.

why.zh-Hant: 切菜和烹調時看得清楚，比較安全。
why.zh-Hans: 切菜和烹调时看得清楚，比较安全。
why.en: Seeing clearly while cutting and cooking is safer.

text.zh-Hant: 玄關保持明亮、整潔。
text.zh-Hans: 玄关保持明亮、整洁。
text.en: Keep the entrance bright and tidy.

why.zh-Hant: 回家第一眼清爽明亮，心情也跟著放鬆；傳統上把入口看作一家的「氣口」。
why.zh-Hans: 回家第一眼清爽明亮，心情也跟着放松；传统上把入口看作一家的“气口”。
why.en: A clear, bright first sight on coming home helps you unwind; tradition sees the entrance as the home's mouth of qi.

text.zh-Hant: 鞋子收進鞋櫃，門口不堆雜物。
text.zh-Hans: 鞋子收进鞋柜，门口不堆杂物。
text.en: Put shoes away in a cabinet, and keep the doorway clear.

why.zh-Hant: 進出順暢，也少絆倒的危險。
why.zh-Hans: 进出顺畅，也少绊倒的危险。
why.en: Coming and going is easy, with less to trip over.

text.zh-Hant: 鏡子不正對大門，可以放在側牆。
text.zh-Hans: 镜子不正对大门，可以放在侧墙。
text.en: Don't hang a mirror facing the front door; put it on a side wall.

why.zh-Hant: 一開門就看見自己的影像容易嚇一跳；側牆上的鏡子出門前一樣能整理儀容。
why.zh-Hans: 一开门就看见自己的影像容易吓一跳；侧墙上的镜子出门前一样能整理仪容。
why.en: Seeing your reflection as the door opens can startle you; a mirror on a side wall still lets you check yourself before going out.

text.zh-Hant: 入門處若能直接看見全屋，可以用屏風或櫃子隔出一點玄關。
text.zh-Hans: 入门处若能直接看见全屋，可以用屏风或柜子隔出一点玄关。
text.en: If the whole home is visible from the door, set off a small entry with a screen or a cabinet.

why.zh-Hant: 多一層隱私，進門也有個轉換心情的地方。
why.zh-Hans: 多一层隐私，进门也有个转换心情的地方。
why.en: It adds privacy, and a place to change pace on arriving.

text.zh-Hant: 餐桌不正對大門或廁所門。
text.zh-Hans: 餐桌不正对大门或厕所门。
text.en: Keep the dining table out of line with the front door and the toilet door.

why.zh-Hant: 用餐時少受進出與氣味打擾，坐得安穩。
why.zh-Hans: 用餐时少受进出与气味打扰，坐得安稳。
why.en: Meals are less disturbed by comings and goings and by smells.

text.zh-Hant: 餐桌上方用溫暖的燈光，桌面保持清爽。
text.zh-Hans: 餐桌上方用温暖的灯光，桌面保持清爽。
text.en: Light the table warmly, and keep it clear.

why.zh-Hant: 溫暖的光讓人願意坐下來好好吃飯、聊天。
why.zh-Hans: 温暖的光让人愿意坐下来好好吃饭、聊天。
why.en: Warm light invites people to sit, eat and talk.

text.zh-Hant: 餐椅後方留出走動的空間。
text.zh-Hans: 餐椅后方留出走动的空间。
text.en: Leave room to walk behind the dining chairs.

why.zh-Hant: 起身、上菜都方便，不會擠來擠去。
why.zh-Hans: 起身、上菜都方便，不会挤来挤去。
why.en: Getting up and serving are easy, without squeezing past.

text.zh-Hant: 床頭靠實牆，床不正對房門。
text.zh-Hans: 床头靠实墙，床不正对房门。
text.en: Put the head of the bed against a solid wall, out of line with the door.

why.zh-Hant: 孩子睡得較有安全感，也少受門外的光線和聲音打擾。
why.zh-Hans: 孩子睡得较有安全感，也少受门外的光线和声音打扰。
why.en: Children feel safer asleep, and are less disturbed by light and noise from outside.

text.zh-Hant: 書桌背後有靠，光線從側面來。
text.zh-Hans: 书桌背后有靠，光线从侧面来。
text.en: Give the desk a wall behind it and light from the side.

why.zh-Hant: 寫作業時較能專心，眼睛也不容易累。
why.zh-Hans: 写作业时较能专心，眼睛也不容易累。
why.en: Homework is easier to focus on, and the eyes tire less.

text.zh-Hant: 家具的尖角加上防撞套，重物不放在高處。
text.zh-Hans: 家具的尖角加上防撞套，重物不放在高处。
text.en: Cover sharp furniture corners, and keep heavy things off high shelves.

why.zh-Hant: 孩子活潑好動，安全最重要。
why.zh-Hans: 孩子活泼好动，安全最重要。
why.en: Children are lively: safety comes first.

text.zh-Hant: 色彩明亮柔和，收納放在孩子拿得到的高度。
text.zh-Hans: 色彩明亮柔和，收纳放在孩子拿得到的高度。
text.en: Use bright, soft colours, and storage at a height the child can reach.

why.zh-Hant: 柔和的顏色讓人安定；孩子能自己收拾，也是一種學習。
why.zh-Hans: 柔和的颜色让人安定；孩子能自己收拾，也是一种学习。
why.en: Soft colours are calming, and tidying up by themselves is part of learning.
